Comment: CloudLab c240g5 (scripts/cloudlab/profile.py: node0 the control node, node1 to node4 the hosts of n1 to n4): the SPFresh example of the update strategies -- SPFresh's maintenance planned per batch and run as major epochs -- on Wikipedia c1024, 4 data nodes, the load constant. The update experiment's four minor batches of the 2026-02 diff (b4x5: 775K inserts and about 744K deletes each, 400 s apart: experiment.wiki-c1024-cloudlab-gpu-updates.json), each followed by an SPFresh epoch: lists longer than 400 split, SPFresh's reassign of the members of the 64 nearest lists, lists shorter than 5 merged into their nearest list with room (SPFresh's paper), every old copy of a moved vector dropped, at most 1300 lists an epoch; no full rebuild and no spare. The index is the one with RNG-pruned replicas (SPFresh builds on SPANN, which picks replicas by the RNG rule; fusion_build --from-index the base index --rng: the base's IDs, raw-vector locations, codebook and page file), inserts and reassigned vectors routed by the same rule, its 64 GP partitions made as the base's, the nodes started on its 4-node warmup snapshot (experiment.wiki-c1024-rng-cloudlab-gpu-warmup-4.json). nprobe 64, N 200 as the update experiment: recall 0.903 on this index against the base's 0.889 (results/rng-index-2026-11-23/summary.txt). Rate = 0.6 x C4 of this index, floored to tens: 540, from C4 909 q/s on the reservation of 2026-11-20 (experiment.wiki-c1024-rng-cloudlab-gpu-calibrate-4.json, 2026-11-26; the base's was 938). SplitLen 400, MergeLen 5 and MajorMax 1300 are the update experiment's: on this index 22 lists are longer than 400 (930 on the base), and a trial of two batches on the lab server (experiment.wiki-c1024-rng-spfresh-trial.json, 2026-11-26) gave 20 and 7 splits, 121 and 107 merges, 2,438 and 1,253 vectors reassigned, 4.6 and 2.1 MB of graph patch, 5-8 s an epoch, so a batch with its epoch takes about as long as the update experiment's batches alone (272-302 s): 400 s apart still leaves time with no update running. The load runs 1800 s, past the fourth batch's epoch (about 1640 s). Answers are scored per data version (scripts/score_answers.py) against <GroundTruth>.versions/ (2026-11-22: the same batches, IDs and locations). UpdateLease 60m and StageTimeout 60m, as the update experiment.
